source_caption:
Brave is one of those Disney movies that feels different when you watch it as an adult.

Released in 2012, the film follows Merida, a headstrong princess who refuses to let tradition decide what her future should look like. But beneath the adventure and magic, it’s really a story about family, expectations, and a mother and daughter trying to understand each other.

What makes Brave so special is that Merida’s story isn’t about finding a prince. There’s no romance to save her. At its heart, it’s about repairing a relationship with her mother and learning that changing your life doesn’t mean you have to stop loving where you came from.

And that beautiful Scottish setting, the music, the atmosphere, and Merida’s wild personality make it one of Pixar’s most memorable films.

It’s a movie about choosing your own path, but also understanding the people who love you along the way.

Have you seen Brave? 🏹
